process_area.title: Agrarian Reform, NCIP Ancestral Domain & Land Use Conversion Operations

value_stream.name: Landbanking, Site Acquisition & Agrarian/LGU Zoning Conversion Operations

fields.Owner: Land Acquisition Manager / Regulatory Compliance Officer
fields.Participants: Department of Agrarian Reform (DAR) Municipal/Provincial offices, Seller
fields.Trigger: Title search (W5130) showing CARP/agrarian patents or agrarian reform land cover

workflows.name: Department of Agrarian Reform (DAR) Clearance & Exemption Application

Controls: - CTL-765 (ensure controlled execution — Agrarian Reform, NCIP Ancestral Domain & Land Use Conversion Operations (PA-178.2).)
- CTL-765: Exemption Order signed by DAR Regional Director or Secretary; verified by Legal before escrow funds release.
Pain Points / Risks: - **CARP coverage block**: Land is designated CARP-distributable and cannot be sold; mitigated by pre-acquisition DAR database checks (W5130).
System Touchpoints: - DAR database, Regulatory compliance manager system (VS-22).

steps.a: Land Acquisition Manager / Regulatory Compliance Officer
steps.activity: Conduct verification at the provincial DAR office to check if the land is subject to Comprehensive Agrarian Reform Program (CARP) coverage or land retention limits.
steps.r: Land Acquisition Manager / Regulatory Compliance Officer

steps.a: Land Acquisition Manager / Regulatory Compliance Officer
steps.activity: File application for DAR Clearance (for private agricultural lands) or Exemption Clearance (for lands reclassified prior to June 15, 1988).
steps.r: Land Acquisition Manager / Regulatory Compliance Officer

steps.a: Land Acquisition Manager / Regulatory Compliance Officer
steps.activity: Coordinate provincial DAR inspection to verify no tenant farmers, active cultivation, or CARP coverage violations exist.
steps.r: Land Acquisition Manager / Regulatory Compliance Officer

steps.a: Land Acquisition Manager / Regulatory Compliance Officer
steps.activity: Secure the formal DAR Clearance Certificate / Exemption Order and file in the transaction folder.
steps.r: Land Acquisition Manager / Regulatory Compliance Officer

fields.Frequency: Per site candidate in targeted regions
fields.Owner: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer
fields.Participants: NCIP Provincial Office, Local Ancestral Domain Office, Legal (VS-100)
fields.Trigger: Approved suitability report (W5129) in regions with high IP density (Mindanao, Northern Luzon)

workflows.name: National Commission on Indigenous Peoples (NCIP) Ancestral Domain Verification

Automation Opportunity: - NCIP database integration for coordinate querying.
Controls: - CTL-141 (ensure land title & acquisition due diligence.)
- CTL-765: Official NCIP mapping clearance report signed by NCIP Regional Director; documented in site feasibility files.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Ancestral domain overlap**: Land is protected IP territory and cannot be commercialized; mitigated by mandatory coordinate check before site payment.
System Touchpoints: - NCIP GIS mapping database, Legal compliance system (VS-100).

steps.a: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer
steps.activity: Submit site coordinates and cadastral maps to the NCIP Provincial Office to request Ancestral Domain Verification.
steps.r: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer

steps.a: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer
steps.activity: Search NCIP records for Certificate of Ancestral Domain Title (CADT) or Certificate of Ancestral Land Title (CALT) overlays on candidate coordinates.
steps.r: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer

steps.a: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer
steps.activity: Obtain official NCIP Geographic Information System (GIS) mapping clearance report.
steps.r: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer

steps.a: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer
steps.activity: Secure NCIP initial assessment indicating if the site falls inside, adjacent to, or outside ancestral domains.
steps.r: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer

fields.Owner: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / CSR Manager
fields.Participants: Indigenous Cultural Community (ICC) Tribal Council, NCIP Elders, CSR Foundation (VS-152), Legal
fields.Trigger: NCIP verification (W5138) showing ancestral domain overlap/contiguity and project proceeding via long-term lease

workflows.name: Free, Prior, and Informed Consent (FPIC) Assessment & Tribal Council Negotiation

Controls: - CTL-765 (ensure controlled execution — Agrarian Reform, NCIP Ancestral Domain & Land Use Conversion Operations (PA-178.2).)
- CTL-765: Certification Precondition issued by NCIP En Banc; MOA signed by Tribal Council, NCIP Chairperson, and BuildRight CEO.
Cross-references: - links to VS-152 (CSR), VS-100 (legal), VS-103 (HR shared services)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Community rejection**: Tribal council rejects commercial lease, blocking site; mitigated by proactive community engagement and generous local hiring commitments.
System Touchpoints: - Tribal community agreements registry, CSR foundation project tracking (VS-152).

steps.a: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / CSR Manager
steps.activity: Initiate formal NCIP FPIC process: request NCIP field team to conduct Field-Based Investigation (FBI).
steps.r: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / CSR Manager

steps.a: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / CSR Manager
steps.activity: Participate in Community Consultative Assemblies: present BuildRight store proposal, economic benefits, jobs, and environmental safeguards to tribal members.
steps.r: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / CSR Manager

steps.a: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / CSR Manager
steps.activity: Negotiate Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) detailing lease rentals, royalty sharing, tribal employment quotas, and CSR community investments (VS-152).
steps.r: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / CSR Manager

steps.a: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / CSR Manager
steps.activity: Secure NCIP En Banc approval of the MOA and issuance of the Certification Precondition (CP).
steps.r: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / CSR Manager

fields.Frequency: Per site clear of ancestral domain in verified zones
fields.Trigger: NCIP verification (W5138) showing site coordinates are clear of ancestral domains

workflows.name: Certificate of Non-Overlap (CNO) Application & Boundary Survey

Automation Opportunity: - CNO application status tracking in land acquisition dashboard.
Controls: - CTL-765 (ensure controlled execution — Agrarian Reform, NCIP Ancestral Domain & Land Use Conversion Operations (PA-178.2).)
- CTL-765: Formal CNO secured and attached to the locational clearance application file.
Pain Points / Risks: - **CNO issuance delay**: Backlog at NCIP office delaying zoning clearance; mitigated by early liaison follow-ups and complete document submission.

steps.a: Land Liaison Officer / Geodetic Engineer
steps.activity: File application for Certificate of Non-Overlap (CNO) at the NCIP Provincial/Regional Office.
steps.r: Land Liaison Officer / Geodetic Engineer

steps.a: Land Liaison Officer / Geodetic Engineer
steps.activity: Submit site Geodetic Plan, TCT technical descriptions, and LGU zoning clearance.
steps.r: Land Liaison Officer / Geodetic Engineer

steps.a: Land Liaison Officer / Geodetic Engineer
steps.activity: Conduct joint NCIP-BuildRight field inspection to verify no IP community occupies or claims the site.
steps.r: Land Liaison Officer / Geodetic Engineer

steps.a: Land Liaison Officer / Geodetic Engineer
steps.activity: Secure the formal Certificate of Non-Overlap (CNO) from the NCIP Regional Director.
steps.r: Land Liaison Officer / Geodetic Engineer

fields.Owner: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer
fields.Participants: Municipal/City Zoning Board, Sanggunian Bayan/Panglungsod (LGU Council), Municipal/City Planning Officer
fields.Trigger: Site has agricultural zoning but is suitable for retail store

Controls: - CTL-765 (ensure controlled execution — Agrarian Reform, NCIP Ancestral Domain & Land Use Conversion Operations (PA-178.2).)
- CTL-765: Certified true copy of Sanggunian Reclassification Ordinance secured and published as legally mandated.
Cross-references: - links to VS-76 (LGU compliance), VS-104 (government affairs)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Council rejection**: LGU council denies reclassification due to local political issues; mitigated by demonstrating community benefits and alignment with city CLUP.
System Touchpoints: - LGU ordinance tracking database, GIS land classification maps.

steps.a: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer
steps.activity: Submit application for Land Reclassification to the Municipal/City Planning and Development Coordinator.
steps.r: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer

steps.a: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer
steps.activity: Provide documentation: land title, DAR certification, environmental clearance, and site plan.
steps.r: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer

steps.a: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer
steps.activity: Attend public hearings at the Sanggunian Bayan/Panglungsod Committee on Housing and Land Use; present justification for the retail development (jobs, tax revenues, convenient hardware sourcing).
steps.r: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer

steps.a: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer
steps.activity: Secure the Sanggunian Ordinance reclassifying the land from agricultural to commercial use.
steps.r: Regulatory Compliance Officer / Land Liaison Officer

fields.Owner: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / Land Legal Specialist
fields.Participants: Department of Agrarian Reform (DAR) — Center for Land Use Policy, Planning and Implementation (CLUPPI) at the Central Office, or the Regional CLUPPI (RCLUPPI) for smaller tracts
fields.Trigger: LGU Reclassification Ordinance secured (W5141) for agricultural land

workflows.name: Land Use Conversion Order Application (DAR Central/Regional level)

Controls: - CTL-765 (ensure controlled execution — Agrarian Reform, NCIP Ancestral Domain & Land Use Conversion Operations (PA-178.2).)
- CTL-765: DAR Conversion Order verified by Legal; performance bond posted and audited (VS-116/VS-21).
Cross-references: - links to VS-116 (performance bonds), VS-15 (P2P), VS-21 (internal audit)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Conversion denial**: DAR rejects conversion due to food security classification of irrigated lands; mitigated by DA (Dept of Agriculture) suitability clearance prior to transaction.
System Touchpoints: - DAR conversion database, Performance bond ledger (VS-116), ERP accounts payable (VS-15).

steps.a: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / Land Legal Specialist
steps.activity: File formal Application for Land Use Conversion at the DAR Provincial/Regional Office.
steps.r: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / Land Legal Specialist

steps.a: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / Land Legal Specialist
steps.activity: Submit comprehensive folder: TCT, LGU Reclassification Ordinance, City Zoning locational clearance, DA Certificate of Eligibility, and DENR ECC.
steps.r: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / Land Legal Specialist

steps.a: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / Land Legal Specialist
steps.activity: Arrange joint CLUPPI site inspection and post public notice of conversion on the property for public inspection.
steps.r: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / Land Legal Specialist

steps.a: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / Land Legal Specialist
steps.activity: Pay conversion fees and post the required performance bond to guarantee development (VS-116).
steps.r: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / Land Legal Specialist

steps.a: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / Land Legal Specialist
steps.activity: Secure the signed Land Use Conversion Order from the DAR Regional Director or Secretary (per DAR AO 1-02, as revised).
steps.r: Director, Facilities & Real Estate / Land Legal Specialist

fields.Participants: Tenant farmers, DAR Municipal Agrarian Reform Officer (MARO), Legal (VS-100), CSR Foundation (VS-152)
fields.Trigger: DAR clearance/conversion process identifying registered or actual tenant farmers on target land

workflows.name: Tenant Farmer Compensation, Settlement & Relocation Governance

Controls: - CTL-765 (ensure controlled execution — Agrarian Reform, NCIP Ancestral Domain & Land Use Conversion Operations (PA-178.2).)
- CTL-765: Quitclaims signed by 100% of identified tenants; MARO representative witness signatures secured; payment disbursements audited.
Cross-references: - links to VS-100 (legal), VS-152 (CSR), VS-19.2 (payroll), VS-121 (TA)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Tenancy dispute / Litigation**: Tenants refuse to vacate or file claims at the DAR Adjudication Board (DARAB); mitigated by fair market valuation and MARO-mediated negotiations.
System Touchpoints: - MARO registration files, CSR project system (VS-152), ERP payroll onboarding (VS-19.2).

steps.a: Land Acquisition Manager / HR Specialist
steps.activity: Conduct census of all actual occupants, tenants, and farmworkers on the target property.
steps.r: Land Acquisition Manager / HR Specialist

steps.a: Land Acquisition Manager / HR Specialist
steps.activity: Negotiate tenant disturbance compensation package (under RA 3844 rules) and voluntary surrender of land tenancy rights.
steps.r: Land Acquisition Manager / HR Specialist

steps.a: Land Acquisition Manager / HR Specialist
steps.activity: Draft Disturbance Compensation Agreements and secure MARO validation and notarization.
steps.r: Land Acquisition Manager / HR Specialist

steps.a: Land Acquisition Manager / HR Specialist
steps.activity: Provide relocation assistance, job retraining programs, and priority employment lists for tenant family members at the new BuildRight store.
steps.r: Land Acquisition Manager / HR Specialist

steps.a: Land Acquisition Manager / HR Specialist
steps.activity: Disburse settlement payments through audited checks and file quitclaims with the DAR.
steps.r: Land Acquisition Manager / HR Specialist

fields.Owner: Director of Construction PMO / Environmental Consultant
fields.Participants: DENR Environmental Management Bureau (EMB), Environmental Compliance Officer (VS-25)
fields.Trigger: Zoning clearance (W5141) and engineering assessment indicating construction footprint requires environmental clearance

workflows.name: DENR Environmental Compliance Certificate (ECC) / CNC Application for New Sites

Automation Opportunity: - Online application tracking and condition reminders.
Controls: - CTL-765 (ensure controlled execution — Agrarian Reform, NCIP Ancestral Domain & Land Use Conversion Operations (PA-178.2).)
- CTL-765: ECC issued before groundbreaking permit application; annual compliance reports filed as required by DENR.
Pain Points / Risks: - **ECC delays**: DENR rejects EIA due to local flooding/drainage issues; mitigated by hydrologist surveys prior to site purchase.
System Touchpoints: - DENR EMB online system, ESG compliance tracker (VS-25), Construction project management portal (VS-112).

steps.a: Director of Construction PMO / Environmental Consultant
steps.activity: Prepare Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) or Initial Environmental Examination (IEE) Checklist for the proposed store size and location.
steps.r: Director of Construction PMO / Environmental Consultant

steps.a: Director of Construction PMO / Environmental Consultant
steps.activity: Submit ECC or CNC (Certificate of Non-Coverage) application on the DENR-EMB online portal.
steps.r: Director of Construction PMO / Environmental Consultant

steps.a: Director of Construction PMO / Environmental Consultant
steps.activity: Address EMB questions, submit engineering plans for sewage treatment plants (STP), drainage, and waste storage.
steps.r: Director of Construction PMO / Environmental Consultant

steps.a: Director of Construction PMO / Environmental Consultant
steps.activity: Secure signed Environmental Compliance Certificate (ECC) containing development conditions; assign conditions to Construction PMO (VS-112) and store operations (VS-25).
steps.r: Director of Construction PMO / Environmental Consultant
